notes:
Quick summary: SprinterByte is a fast-growing e-commerce marketplace focused on next-day fulfillment. They have 4M monthly active users; product pages and search are latency sensitive. Looking to replace an in-house microservice serving cold-start recommendations with a model-backed real-time recommender.

Business priorities: reduce time-to-first-recommendation (TTFR) and cost per session. Target: p95 end-to-end recommendation response <= 120ms in NA, p50 ~40ms; throughput target 1.5-2k qps for peak catalog browsing; cost target ~ <$0.10 per 1k recommendations (strict).

Technical requirements & interest areas: strong interest in batching (dynamic batching across short windows), KV/prefix caching for repeated session context, and 4-bit/8-bit quantization for lower memory footprint. Want Redwood Optimize recommendations (batch size heuristics + quantization profile) and an in-platform perf benchmark run comparing: A) dedicated A10G-like pool with int8 quant; B) burst/GPU sharing on hosted API; C) private on-prem node (for later).

Security/compliance: customer requires SSO (SAML), KMS integration for envelope encryption, audit logging for per-request tracing, and firm data residency controls (EU for EU customers). They listed SOC2 as mandatory for procurement; currently have SOC2 Type II in progress (expected 2026-Q3).

Recent timeline: - 2025-11-10: Intro call (Jordan & Priya) — high-level use case and metrics captured (fireflies ff_20251110_001).
- 2025-12-05: Technical deep-dive with engineering (data shapes, session key schema, sample traffic). Priya led model/hardware discussion.
- 2025-12-15: Security questionnaire submitted (drive:/sprinterbyte/security/sq_response_20251215.xlsx).
- 2026-01-10: PoC kickoff call (ff_20260110_kickoff) — agreed on 2-week benchmark matrix and dataset hygiene steps.
- 2026-02-22: Preliminary perf report received from customer; asked Redwood to run controlled lab benchmarks and provide quantization recommendations.

POC & technical scope for Redwood: 1) Spin up a Dedicated trial pool (2 nodes) and run Redwood-run perf harness against SprinterByte test set (10M request mix emulation) to measure p50/p95/p99 and tokens-per-second. 2) Test caching efficacy: simulate repeated session keys and measure KV cache hit ratio and latency improvement. 3) Run quantization matrix (fp16, int8, 4-bit) for candidate models and report quality delta (top-5 rerank NDCG) and latency/cost tradeoffs. 4) Produce Optimize recommendations (batching settings, cache TTLs, fallback routing policy).

Customer quotes / call highlights: - CTO (Marta Ruiz): "If we can't get p95 < 120ms for recommendations our conversion drops. Latency is the primary KPI." - Head of ML: wants deterministic benchmarking against internal baseline and explicit cost per 1k recs numbers.

Integration notes: sample payload size ~1.2KB (session + 24 candidate ids). Preferred flow: synchronous API with streaming support for gradual UI rendering. They will need SDK snippets for Node + Go and a test harness that can replay traffic with realistic inter-arrival times.

Next steps (detailed): - Confirm test dataset and provide replay harness by 2026-03-05 (SprinterByte owns). - Redwood to schedule dedicated lab benchmarking week (target 2026-03-15 to 2026-03-22). - Legal to review data residency addendum (SprinterByte to push internal legal). - Budget committee meeting 2026-03-10 (blocker).

Notes quality: shorthand and action-driven. Priorities: perf benchmarks -> decision; security addendum -> procurement; budget -> close.
